items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: You know where Mr. Collins stayed at?

ctx.x: Is that Raleigh? Might be. It's something in there, I'm taking pictures of it. That boy used to stay around the corner by a big George place.
That his name, Emile Raleigh? You know big George at the ballroom? You know where Mr. Collins stayed at?
I used to go play a lot with a big boy.
